turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
My son found out about a zero from his phone, in class. On what basis?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
Before I came in. So the office knows, Hale. Is anything on his record right now, and under which section?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
Policy is policy. I printed yours, and it says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me, so answer what I asked: is anything on his record?
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. Your own procedure required this meeting before the mark went in. You've dodged his record twice, so the principal can answer it today.
